description: Engineering Research Capability Registry V1. Known capabilities only: every entry is something this project has built, tested or released. Nothing here is installed or connected automatically; the resolver only recommends.

entries.name: Engineering Research (RUN skill)
entries.purpose: Governed, evidence-graded engineering product/component selection research: draft SPEC and stop at G1, discover candidates, grade evidence per requirement, lanes, SOFT ranking, DECISION_MEMO, CRITIC_BRIEF handoff, apply CRITIC_RESULT, stop at G2.

install.instructions: claude plugin marketplace add alsterling/engineering-research; claude plugin install engineering-research@engineering-research-marketplace

limitations: Selection-dominant: does not do design, sizing, physics or field/design expert work (Problem Router / Field-Design Expert is P4, not started).
Public or synthetic T0 information only; no confidential, export-controlled or customer data.
Does not certify, approve or guarantee a product; a qualified engineer makes the selection.
Never performs CRITIC mode; the critic must run in a separate fresh session.
Discovery depends on the web search/fetch tools of the host session.
entries.trust: Runtime v0.5 RC3 (tag engineering-research-v0.5-rc3, f3a86fe): full model qualification PASS, 27 cases / 85 runs, pass^k = 1.0. Public Alpha v0.5.0-alpha.1, release commit a7dfbbc2be82bd8ace40c13342a0d0839ce17a4d, clean install PASS, runtime integrity 38/38. Frozen: do not modify.

entries.name: Engineering Research Critic (CRITIC skill)
entries.purpose: Independent critic for an Engineering Research run: from a CRITIC_BRIEF only, Job 1 attacks the leading candidate and Job 2 checks one missed product family; returns a CRITIC_RESULT with advisory C1-C4 and an outcome label.

install.instructions: Installed with the engineering-research plugin: claude plugin marketplace add alsterling/engineering-research; claude plugin install engineering-research@engineering-research-marketplace

limitations: Only reviews an Engineering Research CRITIC_BRIEF; not a general-purpose design or document reviewer.
Must run in a fresh session; a sub-agent, fork or resumed conversation is not independent.
Critic labels are advisory; the RUN skill and the human apply them.
Public or synthetic T0 information only.
entries.trust: Same qualification and release as engineering-research (RC3 PASS, Public Alpha v0.5.0-alpha.1, runtime integrity 38/38). Frozen: do not modify.

entries.name: er-core deterministic checks
entries.purpose: Deterministic mechanical rule enforcement for Engineering Research v0.5 artifacts: canonical schemas, lanes and gates, HARD PASS traceability, C1-C4 and outcome label, supersession, SOFT ordering, exact unit conversion, repository hygiene lint.

install.instructions: Use from a checkout of the development repository with standard-library Python 3.10+: python er-core/tools/er_check.py --spec SPEC.json --check CHECK_RESULT.json

limitations: Encodes no rule of its own; only rules that exist in the Engineering Research rule base.
Does not judge applicability, predicate satisfaction or whether a critic finding is right.
Not part of the Public Alpha plugin; development repository only.
entries.trust: Internal tool, 138 deterministic tests passing on the Public Alpha development state; standard library only, no network.

entries.name: Capability Resolver V1.1
entries.purpose: Decide USE / INTEGRATE / SEARCH_REQUIRED / BUILD for a requested capability from this registry and recorded search evidence, so nothing is custom-built when an existing capability suffices.

install.instructions: Use from a checkout of the development repository: python skills/capability-resolver/scripts/resolver.py --request REQUEST.json

limitations: Knows only what is in this registry and in the evidence given to it; external discovery adapters (so far GitHub search) return UNREVIEWED candidates that need human review before the resolver uses them.
Exact capability-tag matching only; no fuzzy or semantic matching.
entries.trust: P2 complete (Resolver V1.1): deterministic tests pass; real-world validation PASS on PUMP-001 (capability-registry/validation/PUMP-001/). Not model-qualified; not published publicly.
